authority: User-confirmed refinements on 2026-11-23; superseding intent must be incorporated into next complete decision baseline, not applied as unvalidated immutable schema.

decisions.rule: AIGMos 1.9 must preserve all demonstrated AIGMos 1.8 functional capabilities across the UNION of valid feature-selected builds. A single minimal MP image need not contain optional features. No 1.8 feature may disappear without explicitly accepted equivalent or replacement.

SYSTEM owns only SYSTEM's own data. TER owns trigger, event and runner definitions/runtime and queues. Q owns its profiles, queues, tasks and history. Layout owns keymap and instances. STATE is a storage service, not a semantic owner.
Named KV-list root uses dot, e.g. $SYSTEM.boot, rather than colon, e.g. $SYSTEM:boot. A colon addresses keys inside that named list. Candidate per-owner list names remain UNLOCKED.
The standard minimal MP build contains no # structured facility. A selected structured Core Module may provide # in compatible other builds. No Hardcore/SYSTEM dependency may implicitly require #.

Component-owned configuration is placed under protected /config. BOOT loads it; CS reload command can request a privileged loader to read/validate/reload it. Ordinary CS cannot read raw /config or write raw /config, including through generic FILE/import/export operations. Do not mirror private configuration wholesale to STATE.

Q is optional at build time. EVERY Q-containing build must include a valid q.default profile; boot must fail if absent or invalid. A Q-free build must not require Q configuration, Q code, Q validators or Q-exclusive dependencies. Q-specific config/validation is Q-owned.

The ONLY runtime/CS-triggered modification permitted inside protected /config is the internal AC activation operation changing ac.enabled false->true. It is a narrow atomic write, not general CS filesystem privilege. CS cannot deactivate AC; deactivation requires configuration edit outside CS and restart. Authorization, exact physical path and transactional error semantics remain open.

Build Tool physically prunes unselected modules, conditional hooks, associated validators/config requirements and exclusive dependencies; external AI interoperability via generic INPUT/EXPOSE does not make AI/Q code part of that build.
Any future direct AIGMos-to-AIGMos transport shall be encrypted, but link protocol and implementation are OUT OF SCOPE for current 1.9 cleanup.
